messages:
alice: FYI after last night's firewall default-deny + KMS key rotation some GPU warm-pool nodes are stuck in init; keystore decrypts timing out and autoscaler can't reach target. Sample log:
```
2026-03-22T02:11:03Z init ERROR keystore decrypt timeout after 90s
2026-03-22T02:11:05Z warmup WARN join attempt failed -> backoff
```
Looks regional: ap-south and eu-west. Not seeing app errors, purely infra/auth.

tom: seeing the same in ap-south-1. Keystore clients use ephemeral ENIs for privatelink; the new SG allowlist only contains static endpoint IPs.

maya: auditshipper is spiking S3 PUTs from retries which will blow monthly when retried across fleet. We should reduce sampling while we fix.

dmitri: quick triage: KMS rekey caused keystore proxy restarts and re-issuance of session creds; ephemeral ENIs weren't whitelisted so many decrypts got AccessDenied/504.

ops-bot: ALERT: gpu-warmup-fail-rate > 4% (5m).

alice: Mitigation plan: 1) apply temporary SG egress rule scoped to keystore ENI CIDR (10.210.32.0/22) port 443, TTL 45m 2) flip auditshipper to 30% sample 3) open terraform PR to add keystore-privatelink exception with revert gate. Keep IAM changes as last resort.

tom: CLI to add rule if approved:
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0b2c3d4e --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.210.32.0/22 --description "temp keystore privatelink"
```
I'll prepare PR and runbook updates.

maya: cost note: temporary warm nodes to cover join issues ~ $3k/day/region, sampling cuts S3 by ~ $2.2k/day. Try to keep window <1h.

ops-bot: ACTION: audit-sampler set to 30% (deploy id ds-3344).

alice: applied SG tweak in staging; 12m later warm-pool nodes start joining, decrypt latencies down to ~150ms. Applying in prod now. Leaving thread open 1h for monitoring. Thanks all :thumbsup:
